name: iRoofer Contractors
description: Roofing contractor in Dallas, GA serving Paulding, Cobb, Douglas, Cherokee and Fulton counties. Roof repair, roof replacement, storm damage restoration, gutters and new construction roofing.

transport.note: Tools are registered client-side by every page of this site via the Model Context API. Load any page and read document.modelContext (navigator.modelContext on older Chromium).

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Contact details, business hours, service area and credentials for iRoofer Contractors.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the roofing and gutter services offered, with a page URL for each.

tools.name: list_service_areas
tools.description: List the Georgia cities and counties served, with a page URL for each.

tools.name: find_service_page
tools.description: Find the best page on the site for a given service and/or city.

tools.name: start_quote_request
tools.description: Fill the free-quote form on the current page with the homeowner's details. Never submits — the human must press the button.

tools.name: call_iroofer
tools.description: Get the phone number to reach iRoofer Contractors, including 24/7 emergency storm response.
